admission.justification: Finite card selection, preserved complete diagnostic material and exact-set file publication together guarantee an end-to-end curation loop that no one member promises alone.

guarantee: A Curator can perform a finite multi-card repair, recover complete diagnostic and candidate material from its named corpus, and publish exact judgments without transferring that corpus into the conversational answer; bounded status and file transport never narrow operation scope or weaken publication authority.
title: Finite memory work with bounded status and complete corpus
